expected_behavior: produces a complete schema-1 scenario YAML (url, viewport, steps) that passes the recorder's validator
follows the craft rules: one zoom per logical step, zoom scale 1.3-2.0, card titles 3-8 words, bodies 8-20 words, pre/post-click pauses respected via defaults
anchors steps on stable selectors (data-testid) and sequences beats zoom-in -> act -> card -> zoom-out
hands off to walkthrough-record for the actual recording instead of running ffmpeg/playwright ad hoc

cases.prompt: Write a recording scenario for our checkout flow at https://shop.test — here's the feature list and the page uses emails and card numbers in test data
expected_behavior: asks for or derives stable selectors instead of inventing brittle ones
adds mask entries for the email/payment fields and flags storageState for the logged-in state
keeps total runtime in the 30-90s band with a hook (hero card) up front and a result/CTA beat at the end

cases.prompt: Our app is dark-themed and the default cards disappear against it — fix the look
expected_behavior: selects or customizes a theme (e.g. the paper preset or inline card colors) rather than editing the recorder engine
keeps card text contrast at or above 4.5:1 per the theming reference
shows the theme block inline in the scenario or as a theme file next to it
